label: Toast
description: A brief, non-blocking message that confirms an action or reports a problem, optionally with one action such as Undo. Optimistic actions (assign, change priority) show a success toast with Undo instead of asking for confirmation first.
usage: Use for results of actions the viewer just took ("Assigned to Network").
Offer Undo for reversible optimistic changes instead of a confirm dialog.
Keep text under 80 characters; never put the only copy of important information in a toast.
constraints: tone and text are required; text is at most 140 characters, actionLabel at most 20.
durationMs is 2000–10000 (default 5000); toasts with an action stay at least 6000 ms; critical toasts stay until dismissed.
At most three toasts are visible; newer ones queue.

binding.description: App-level pattern raised by the platform and elements, not placed in views.

accessibility.keyboard: Toasts never take focus. Alt+T moves focus to the latest toast; Enter runs its action; Esc dismisses.
accessibility.notes: info/success use role=status; warning/critical use role=alert. The timer pauses on hover and focus.

responsive: Bottom-right on desktop; full-width at the bottom below 720px, above the composer.
